```{python}
#| label: fig-nmos-triode
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "NMOS output characteristic in the triode region according to the square-law model ($\\mu_\\mathrm{n} C'_\\mathrm{ox} = 280\\,\\mathrm{\\mu A/V^2}$, $W/L = 10$, $V_\\mathrm{th} = 0.5\\,$V). Each curve ends at the edge of saturation, $V_\\mathrm{DS} = V_\\mathrm{GS} - V_\\mathrm{th}$."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

k = 2800e-6   # un*Cox*W/L in A/V^2
vth = 0.5

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
for vgs in [0.6, 0.7, 0.9]:
    vod = vgs - vth
    vds = np.linspace(0, vod, 100)
    idr = k * (vod * vds - vds**2 / 2) * 1e6
    ax.plot(vds, idr, 'b-', lw=2)
    ax.annotate(f'$V_\\mathrm{{GS}} = {vgs}\\,$V', xy=(vod, idr[-1]),
                xytext=(vod + 0.03, idr[-1]), fontsize=9, va='center')

ax.set_xlabel('$V_\\mathrm{DS}$ (V)')
ax.set_ylabel('$I_\\mathrm{D}$ (µA)')
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 250)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
